Name: Ghost Bond XL Wig Fixing Glue, White, 38 ml
Short description: Water and sweat resistant wig adhesive for lace and poly hair systems. 38 ml.
Description:
Ghost Bond XL comes from the same makers as the original formula, with better resistance to water and moisture. It has extra moisture protection and a higher melting point, so the bond holds up in intense climates. It is made for oily scalps, high humidity and heavy perspiration.

Key features

  • Easy application and clean-up
  • Forms a barrier against scalp oil
  • Resists lifting in high humidity
  • Keeps heavy perspiration away from attachments
  • Heat-resistant and anti-bacterial
  • No latex, no harsh solvents

How to use

Shake well. Apply one thin coat to the hair system base and four thin coats to the head. Apply each coat as soon as the previous one turns clear (about 20 seconds). After the fourth coat, wait 7 minutes and press the hair system into place. For lace, follow the same steps but do not apply glue to the lace base. Apply to the scalp only.

Do a patch test on a small area of skin 24 hours before first use.
